download_models: download the TableFormerV2 model from HuggingFace to a local directory
predict_tables: predict table structures on document pages using the TableFormerV2 model
build_table_cells: build table cell structures from an OTSL sequence and predicted bounding boxes
decode_otsl_sequence: decode token IDs into an OTSL tag sequence for table structure parsing
match_text: match text from page text cells to table cell bounding boxes by overlap
